title: 3.1.7d Lab — Scale a Shape
description: Stretch a Cube non-uniformly by setting scale.x and scale.y to different values.

steps.title: Create a Cube
steps.instructions: In setup(), write `cube = new Cube(0, 0, 0)` to place a unit cube at the origin.
hints: A unit cube starts at scale 1 in all directions — a perfect cube.

steps.title: Make it twice as wide
steps.instructions: Set `cube.scale.x = 2` to stretch the cube to twice its width along the X axis.
hints: scale.x = 2 means 'two times the original width'. The cube becomes a wide slab.

steps.title: Make it half as tall
steps.instructions: Set `cube.scale.y = 0.5` to squish the cube to half its height.
hints: scale.y = 0.5 means half the original height. Combined with scale.x = 2 you get a flat wide slab.
